scope: CodecDelay and signed whole-Block padding, including lacing, global-delay intersections, compressed presentation seeks and empty output. Fine block clocks describe the intended compressed presentation. Independent sample masks select untimed source PCM; Opus/AAC seeks use fresh source seeks. Codec DSP, timestamp scheduling and SeekPreRoll have separate suites. Guarded mutations are capped at 128 reads and seek at 64.

ffmpeg_comparator_limits: FFmpeg 8.0.1 exposes CodecDelay as initial_padding without applying generic skip_samples; whole-block laced padding is checked against the normative mask rather than repeated per-lace trimming.
